ALGER — Les ministères des Affaires étra: ALGIERS — The Ministries of Foreign Affairs, Interior, Local Communities, and Transport launched, on Wednesday, a digital service enabling Algerians living abroad to renew their biometric passports remotely. This system, initially deployed at the Consulate General of Algeria in Paris, will be gradually extended to all diplomatic representations.
Le ministre de l'Intérieur, des Collecti: The Minister of Interior, Local Communities, and Transport, Mr. Saïd Sayoud, indicated that this project is part of presidential guidelines aimed at accelerating the modernization of public services. "This digital service guarantees more efficient, transparent, and simplified procedures, strengthening trust between citizens and institutions," he stated during the launch ceremony at the headquarters of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
M. Sayoud a ajouté que cette initiative: Mr. Sayoud added that this initiative reflects the importance attached by the State to members of the national community residing abroad, by offering them modern consular services tailored to their needs. "The digital system makes it possible to submit and track a passport renewal request without repeated trips to the consulate," he explained.
Le ministre a souligné que la plateforme: The minister emphasized that the platform, accessible around the clock, reduces administrative delays and efforts while ensuring the protection of personal data. "The security standards implemented guarantee the integrity of the procedures and the digital sovereignty of the State," he affirmed.
Le secrétaire d'État chargé de la Commun: The Secretary of State in charge of the National Community Abroad, Mr. Sofiane Chaib, described this procedure as "simplified and innovative," illustrating the commitment of institutions to place the citizen at the heart of administrative reforms.
